'''Grasshoppers''' are a species of unremarkable [[above ground]] [[vermin]] who may be found in any non-freezing [[biome]].

Some dwarves [[Preferences|like]] grasshoppers for their ''chirping'' and their ''great leaps''.

{{Translation| dwarven = isin-ikus | elvish = enena-ayefi | goblin = struxe-angnu | human = kege-buh}}
